eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Pima, AZ; at 10:59 AM on AUG 20, 2025 Effective until 8:59 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A Silver Alert has been issued for Tucson, Arizona. Tucson Police Department is looking for 79-year-old Hispanic male, Teodoro Sanchez. He is 5 feet 4 inches tall, 135 pounds with grey hair and brown eyes. He was last contacted in the area of East 36th Street and Country Club Road in Tucson, Arizona. It is unknown what Mr. Sanchez was last wearing, but he typically wears a dark-colored beanie hat. He may have a basic flip-style cellular phone with him that is likely out of battery. His family has not heard from him since 08/04/2025. If you have contact with this Silver Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
